0022600128.text: The Brooklyn Nets (0-3, on a three-game losing streak) visit the Boston Celtics (2-1, on a two-game winning streak) for the Nets' fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with Brooklyn 14th in the East and 2.5 games behind for fifth in the Atlantic, while Boston sits 2nd in the Atlantic and 5th in the East. Tyler Bilodeau is out for the Nets with a shoulder sprain, and the Celtics will be without Devin Carter, who is out with an illness, while Derrick White is day-to-day with a hip injury and is a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and in the 2025-26 season series the Nets lost 1-3, including a 148-111 defeat in Boston in their last meeting.
